nameEn: Manufacture of articles of concrete, cement and plaster
description: This class includes the manufacture of articles of concrete, cement and plaster for use in construction and other purposes.
includes: manufacture of boards, sheets, panels, tiles and similar articles of vegetable fibre, straw or wood waste agglomerated with cement, plaster or other mineral binders
manufacture of precast concrete, cement or artificial stone articles for construction: tiles, flagstones, bricks, boards, sheets, panels, pipes, posts, fencing
manufacture of prefabricated structural components of concrete for building or civil engineering
manufacture of plaster articles: boards, sheets, panels
manufacture of other articles of concrete, plaster and cement: statues, furniture, bas-reliefs, flowerpots, ornamental items
excludes: manufacture of ceramic building materials, see 2392
